title: The Living Spirit's Constructive Works
description: Three numbered enumerations of the Lord's operative power building structure. T32 names seven works: raising the Divine Human as a pearl from the sea, spreading the suffering one through every body, fixing the substances of death, establishing the doctrinal vessels, summoning the rational and stationing utterances, surrounding the bound circuit, and sending forth the glorious image. T33 describes five supports the operative power has set within the very body of the proprium itself: the bearing-disc, the path of regeneration through the middle, the shaping of the lowest, four pillars in the sea, and four walls around the strongholds. T34 enumerates further ordering works carried out within the captive natural — building anew, filling the heights with vessels, setting cycles, joining earth to higher worlds, opening gates inward, sealing some, separating night and day, casting down abortions.
